workflow_data.question: When you imagine the next five years of your life, what's the one thing you most don't want to look back and regret — and what would it take to make sure you don't?
workflow_data.context:
Second solo smoke test of the Circle prototype, primarily to see how the
facilitator behaves after the prompt updates around pacing, single-question
turns, and earlier reflection. The question is deliberately personal and
open-ended so the bot has room to probe (or, ideally, to wrap gracefully
when the participant feels done).
